source: the structure of the ring sheet below and among the measured knots of ringfield.json: a ladder of octaves of ringlets by radius (plateaus with jittered edges, a groove at each edge), wave trains, and the hue each ringlet takes. Lengths in planet radii. Read by field.ts.

groove.note: half width of a groove in cells, narrowest and widest; the share of edges that carry none; how much a groove darkens the sheet and how much it opens it, per unit of strength

waves.note: each train: radius of the resonance, length, wavelength at its far end, 1 for outward and -1 for inward. rise and fall are fractions of the length; tight caps how short the waves get near the resonance.
